; Bouton « 4 cases » (3 crayons + gomme) à la place du contenu du bouton du crayon secondaire.
; Contenu : /home/root/xovi/crayons/Quad.qml, rechargé quand /home/root/xovi/crayons/quad.version change.
AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/SecondaryPenMenu.qml
    TRAVERSE WritingTool
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            iconSource: ""
            content: Item {
                id: quadZone
                anchors.fill: parent
                property int version: 0
                Timer {
                    interval: 2000
                    repeat: true
                    running: true
                    onTriggered: {
                        const x = new XMLHttpRequest();
                        x.open("GET", "file:///home/root/xovi/crayons/quad.version", false);
                        try { x.send(); const v = parseInt(x.responseText) || 0; if (v !== quadZone.version) quadZone.version = v; } catch (e) {}
                    }
                }
                Loader {
                    anchors.fill: parent
                    source: "file:///home/root/xovi/crayons/Quad.qml?v=" + quadZone.version
                    onLoaded: item.tool = root
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
